title: Building
description: Public projection of a building. The address follows the Czech OFN "Adresy" (2020-07-01) standard, anchored on the RÚIAN address-point code; coordinates are the precise stored values (open data, no anonymization).

address.description: Czech OFN address. The RÚIAN address-point code is the canonical anchor; street name, orientation number, municipal part, district (okres) and region (kraj) are optional. The *Code fields are the RÚIAN codes backing the OFN territorial IRIs (ulice, obec, část obce, okres, VÚSC/kraj); in the JSON-LD projection they are emitted as dereferenceable https://linked.cuzk.cz/resource/ruian/… IRIs.

streetName.description: název ulice (optional — small municipalities have no streets).

streetCode.description: RÚIAN kód ulice → OFN ulice IRI.

municipalityCode.description: RÚIAN kód obce → OFN obec IRI.

municipalityPartCode.description: RÚIAN kód části obce → OFN část_obce IRI.

districtCode.description: RÚIAN kód okresu → OFN okres IRI.

regionCode.description: RÚIAN kód VÚSC (kraje) → OFN vúsc IRI.
